atlas_conditions.interpretation: Generic dominant-matrix row boundaries only; Atlas query geometry is unpublished and remains numerically null.

comparison_contract.same_compute_storage_attribution: same ROM-wafer compute and pipeline; immutable weights move between that profile's HBM service and ROM service
comparison_contract.shared_omission_condition: An identical nonnegative serialized term can only reduce attribution when ROM weight service is no slower than HBM; architecture-dependent mutable and communication costs are outside this row-only screen.

evidence_boundary: No audited recent model was executed by OpenTallas.
Atlas and RTFM disclose no model size, latent query geometry, denoising schedule, cache tensor inventory, latency, or exact hardware.

Four surveyed row counts are source-derived favorable current-block lower bounds; EVOKE's temporal factor and H3's text-row component are explicit assumptions. None is a complete FLOP, KV, attention, communication, or VAE model.
The zero-cost-ROM result is a storage-only upper endpoint, not a prediction.
The actual B300-versus-ROM architecture ratio changes compute as well as storage and is not storage attribution.
Atlas and RTFM are dated mutable-page observations without retained snapshots; the open implementations use commit and file pins.
OpenTallas has no video ABI/compiler/runtime/RTL or fabricated ROM implementation for any audited model.

inventory_models.architecture: multimodal autoregressive rectified-flow transformer; video is a sequence of image elements
inventory_models.cache_semantics: Vendor says the autoregressive architecture can use KV caching, cache-aware routing, and disaggregated serving; exact released cache tensors and schedule are not disclosed.
inventory_models.open_release_status: early access to select partners; the checked vendor page links no public weights, code, or technical report
inventory_models.published_runtime: Up to one minute of 1440p output is advertised; no generation latency, hardware, model size, tokenizer geometry, or denoising-step count is published.

inventory_models.architecture: autoregressive diffusion transformer predicting one frame conditioned on previous posed frames
inventory_models.cache_semantics: Input frames are explicitly converted to a KV cache; nearby posed frames are retrieved through context juggling to bound history.
inventory_models.open_release_status: research preview; the checked vendor page links no public weights, code, parameter count, latent grid, or denoising schedule
inventory_models.published_runtime: Interactive frame rates on one H100; no exact fps or latency table is published.

inventory_models.architecture: 14B, three-stage/three-call CFG-free autoregressive latent-video world model with an external camera-indexed state bank
inventory_models.cache_semantics: The released post-distillation launcher pins restrict_self_attn=false and use_kv_cache=false. Bounded external world state is not a persistent DiT history-KV cache.
inventory_models.current_rows_derivation: 9 latent frames * (384 / 8 / 2) * (640 / 8 / 2) = 8,640 current high-resolution patch rows
inventory_models.published_runtime: 1.5 seconds (36 frames) of 384x640 video in 2.11 seconds on one H200

row_evidence.source: The pinned launcher and loader support the spatial factors; the 36-output-frame to 9-latent-frame temporal factor remains an explicit favorable assumption.

inventory_models.architecture: LTX-2.3 22B-based, four-step autoregressive latent-chunk world model with explicit 3D and compressed history memory
inventory_models.cache_semantics: No persistent DiT history-KV decode path appears in the three pinned files checked; the KV objects in those files belong to the ViGeo geometry subsystem.
inventory_models.current_rows_derivation: 4 output latent frames * (544 / 32) * (960 / 32) = 2,040 current rows; history, sink, and 1,369 spatial-memory tokens are excluded favorably
inventory_models.open_release_status: training/inference code and v1.1 weights released
inventory_models.published_runtime: Described as real-time interactive; the pinned README does not provide a hardware-normalized latency table for this path.

row_evidence.source: The current-row factors are arithmetic from the pinned inference config and LTX-2.3 model config listed below.

inventory_models.architecture: 14B Wan2.2-based causal few-step video world model
inventory_models.cache_semantics: Released causal inference uses a per-layer KV cache with an 18-latent-frame local window and six sink frames; each step still queries a three-latent-frame current block, followed by a clean cache-install pass.
inventory_models.open_release_status: causal-fast inference code and model released; production deployment code withheld
inventory_models.published_runtime: Official materials describe real-time deployments; the released reference command uses eight GPUs and does not publish a reproducible fps/latency result.

row_evidence.source: The current-query row factors are arithmetic from the pinned causal-fast implementation and configuration listed below.

inventory_models.architecture: 8B HunyuanVideo-1.5-based, four-step autoregressive chunk model with reconstituted context memory
inventory_models.cache_semantics: Text K/V is cached. Selected visual history is recomputed into a per-layer K/V cache at each chunk and reused across current-chunk denoising; it is not an ever-growing free history cache.
inventory_models.current_rows_derivation: 4 current latent frames * (480 / 16 / 2) * (832 / 16 / 2) = 1,560 current rows in the documented 480x832 setting; selected-history cache construction is excluded favorably
inventory_models.published_runtime: Claims 24-fps streaming; the reference launcher uses up to eight inference GPUs.

row_evidence.source: The current-row factors are arithmetic from the pinned launcher, pipeline, and transformer files listed below.

inventory_models.architecture: 5B memory-augmented bidirectional DiT with outer multi-segment autoregression, three-step DMD, INT8 weights, and a streamed VAE
inventory_models.cache_semantics: Past/current/memory latent rows are jointly reprocessed by the released bidirectional denoiser; camera-selected memory is frame reinjection, not persistent transformer K/V decode.
inventory_models.current_rows_derivation: 10 newly emitted latent frames * (704 / 16 / 2) * (1280 / 16 / 2) = 8,800 fresh-row lower bound per later segment; the actual denoiser also processes four overlap and five memory latent frames
inventory_models.published_runtime: Up to 40 fps at 720p is reported; the public inference command generates 704x1280 segments with three steps.

row_evidence.source: The fresh-row factors are arithmetic from the pinned report, inference pipeline, and configuration listed below.

inventory_models.architecture: unified Mixture-of-Transformers with a causal AR reasoner tower and a full-attention diffusion generator tower
inventory_models.cache_semantics: The reasoner is ordinary next-token causal decode and is a candidate for a separate language-style screen. Generator diffusion queries bidirectional noisy visual/audio/action blocks; the reasoner cache does not turn generator output into tokenwise decode.
inventory_models.published_runtime: Official generator benchmarks report mode/resolution/hardware-specific latency; reasoner benchmarks separately report output-token serving.

inventory_models.architecture: 500M axial DiT after a proposed exact causal temporal-KV transformation
inventory_models.cache_semantics: OpenTallas proposal, not released Oasis behavior; current-frame temporal queries read cached past-frame K/V.
inventory_models.open_release_status: public Oasis code; cache transformation remains unimplemented
inventory_models.published_runtime: Existing OpenTallas study only; not a product result

row_evidence.source: results/world-model/analytical.json and its pinned Oasis inventory

inventory_models.cache_semantics: No persistent autoregressive K/V: noisy packed positions are recomputed on every denoising call.
inventory_models.current_rows_derivation: 37 latent video frames * (1344 / 32) * (768 / 32) + 414 audio rows + an assumed 512 text rows = 38,222 packed rows
inventory_models.published_runtime: Existing OpenTallas study calibrates against a published 8xB300 software result

row_evidence.source: results/world-model/analytical.json; the 512 text-row component remains an explicit assumption in its pinned configuration
